title: Prefer browser-native first
principle: Reach for native platform capabilities (HTML, CSS, built-in APIs) before heavy custom libraries—less weight, more resilience.
procedure: List features that HTML/CSS/ARIA already provide.
Use native controls where accessible defaults are good enough.
Add libraries only when native can’t meet a measured need.
Document why each dependency earned its weight.
Revisit dependencies when browsers catch up.
examplePrompts:
Audit this UI for browser-native opportunities.

Replace custom with native where possible.
For each remaining library: measured need + weight.
Prefer progressive enhancement.
Cut vanity dependencies.
tips: Jim’s writing often champions working with the web platform.
